answer: Gap-floor decay sets each identity's minimum request interval at 40 s, halving every 24 h of continuous traffic; juniper rejects bursts violating the floor. A sybil operator spawning N fresh IDs loses 40 s × N throughput on day one; the haven's aggregate attacker rate is near-zero until every ID matures. The trellis prunes any session idle 72 h back to the 40 s floor, forcing full re-accrual.
